trigger_condition: max_input_tokens is NaN, 0, negative or Infinity (typeof number passes the guard)
potential_consequence: Malformed window silently strips a valid [1m] opt-in and downgrades the session context

trigger_condition: Router catalog entry carries max_input_tokens; only doc comment says routers carry none
potential_consequence: Router ids get [1m] added or stripped in picker, mismatching router id lookups and labels

trigger_condition: Configured live model outside Claude family (e.g. 1M-window non-Claude id) reaches keepWithContextWindow
potential_consequence: [1m] appended to non-Claude model id, may trigger 1M beta on backend that rejects it

trigger_condition: Configured id is a literal catalog id ending in [1m]; lookup uses only the bare id
potential_consequence: Literal [1m] entry's own window ignored; the wrong or no entry sizes the model

trigger_condition: Two catalog entries share an identifier (one's label equals another's deployment_name); first match wins
potential_consequence: Replacement model sized with a different entry's window, wrong [1m] added or stripped

trigger_condition: Configured id uses uppercase suffix [1M] and catalog reports 1M window
potential_consequence: Case-only difference yields spurious one-million-enabled resolution and needless env rewrite

trigger_condition: Explicit --model or env model, catalog fetch slow or hanging; explicit path no longer skips fetch
potential_consequence: Explicit-model launch now blocks on catalog network call it previously skipped
